patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — GoTo Connect and Microsoft Teams share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose GoTo Connect only if your buying job matches “Remote-team UCaaS phone system with meetings and messaging — Phone System / CX / Contact C” rather than Microsoft Teams's shape. Choose Microsoft Teams only if your buying job matches “M365 collaboration hub (chat, meetings, files) with optional Teams Phone telephony add-on ” rather than GoTo Connect's shape. Workflow advantage: GoTo Connect leans business-phone, contact-center; Microsoft Teams leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — GoTo Connect and Microsoft Teams share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: GoTo Connect is Remote-team UCaaS phone system with meetings and messaging — Phone System / CX / Contact Center ladders are custom-quote (no public seat dol; Microsoft Teams is M365 collaboration hub (chat, meetings, files) with optional Teams Phone telephony add-on — free Teams tier exists; Phone Standard ~$10/user.
- Company-size focus: GoTo Connect (small-business, mid-market) vs Microsoft Teams (small-business, mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: GoTo Connect-leaning business-phone, contact-center vs Microsoft Teams-leaning —.
- Researched limits: GoTo Connect — No published self-serve seat dollars — every plan is sales-quoted; Microsoft Teams — Scored as a collaboration hub — Teams Phone is a telephony add-on, not the primary scored job.

Limitations — GoTo Connect: No published self-serve seat dollars — every plan is sales-quoted; Industry dollar ranges are low confidence and must not be treated as list prices; Microsoft Teams: Scored as a collaboration hub — Teams Phone is a telephony add-on, not the primary scored job; Teams Phone requires an eligible Teams/M365 licence plus PSTN (PAYG or Calling Plan).

Poor-fit cases: GoTo Connect is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No published self-serve seat dollars — every plan is sales-quoted · Microsoft Teams is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Scored as a collaboration hub — Teams Phone is a telephony add-on, not the primary scored job · Avoid GoTo Connect if you actually need Microsoft Teams's motion (M365 collaboration hub (chat, meetings, files) with optional Teams Phone telepho)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
